lines.cap: The US Navy needed help winning a world war. So they called the mafia. In prison.
lines.say: The US Navy needed help winning a world war. So they called the mafia. In prison.

lines.cap: Lucky Luciano. He turned the American mafia into a business, with a board of directors. The Commission.
lines.say: Lucky Luciano. He turned the American mafia into a business, with a board of directors. The Commission.

lines.cap: In 1936, he was sent to prison for thirty to fifty years. Running prostitution rings.
lines.say: In 1936, he was sent to prison for thirty to fifty years. Running prostitution rings.

lines.cap: Then, 1942. A giant French liner, the Normandie, catches fire in New York harbour and rolls over. People suspect Nazi saboteurs on the docks.
lines.say: Then, 1942. A giant French liner, the Normandie, catches fire in New York harbour and rolls over. People suspect Nazi saboteurs on the docks.

lines.cap: The docks belonged to the mob. So Naval Intelligence did the unthinkable. They asked Lucky for help.
lines.say: The docks belonged to the mob. So Naval Intelligence did the unthinkable. They asked Lucky for help.

lines.cap: From his cell, Luciano sends word. Watch the docks. Report spies. Keep the dockworkers quiet.
lines.say: From his cell, Luciano sends word. Watch the docks. Report spies. Keep the dockworkers quiet.

lines.cap: After the war, the governor cut his sentence short. On one condition. He gets deported to Italy. Forever.
lines.say: After the war, the governor cut his sentence short. On one condition. He gets deported to Italy. Forever.

lines.cap: As his ship sailed, reports say his gangster friends threw him a farewell party on board. With lobster.
lines.say: As his ship sailed, reports say his gangster friends threw him a farewell party on board. With lobster.
